ov: The largest marsupials, and the only large mammals that get around mainly by hopping on two legs. The name covers four big species: the red, antilopine, eastern grey and western grey kangaroo.

why.ac: Many kangaroos are nocturnal or crepuscular, resting in the shade on hot days and feeding in the cool of evening, night and early morning.
why.dg: Unprovoked attacks on people are very rare.
why.et: Wild kangaroos are shot for meat, which is valued for being low in fat, and they have always been an important food for Aboriginal Australians.

len: 1.3–1.6 m plus a 1.2 m tail (male red kangaroo)
wt: Female red kangaroos 18–40 kg; males about twice that
df: Mostly grass, cropped close to the ground with specialised teeth. Some species also eat a lot of shrubs.

cf.tip: Wallabies are the smaller members of the same family. Kangaroos are the largest, with wallaroos in between.
